annotations.title: Scan a webpage for AI readiness

description: Returns a readiness score, passed and failed checks, category results, top fixes, limitations, and a report link for one public webpage. Use it when someone asks whether a webpage is accessible and usable by AI agents; for checking an MCP server's directory compliance, use check_mcp_server_directory_rules instead. Pass url to scan the page directly, or use the reportUrl to revisit the detailed results.

url.description: Public webpage address to scan, such as https://example.com or example.com/pricing.

name: scan_webpage_ai_readiness
